items.text: NY Jets QB: Geno Smith (left ankle; also checked for concussion) avoided a major injury per tests; Aaron Glenn says he starts if healthy. Rookie Cade Klubnik, who played half of Week 10, starts if not. Watch Wednesday-Friday practice.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. NY Jets: QUESTIONABLE - WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle), G Dylan Parham (knee). IR - OT Max Mitchell, DT T'Vondre Sweat, WR Arian Smith.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. LA Chargers: WR Ladd McConkey (back) out last week; DOUBTFUL - WR Brenen Thompson (hamstring). TE David Njoku and LB Denzel Perryman activated from IR. IR - S Derwin James Jr., OT Rashawn Slater, OL Branson Taylor. Justin Herbert starts.
